hero.title: From Concept to Container
hero.subtitle: Asia Global Textiles connects international importers with capable Pakistani vendors and keeps every order moving with clear communication, quality supervision, and shipment discipline.

intro.title: A sourcing partner, not just another supplier
intro.body: We connect importers and fashion brands with the right apparel and denim factories in Pakistan, and manage the details, from sampling to shipment, so every order arrives dependable, on time, and at a fair price.

pillars.title: Direct factory access
pillars.desc: A trusted network of apparel and denim manufacturers across Pakistan.

pillars.title: One accountable partner
pillars.desc: A single point of contact from first enquiry through final delivery.

pillars.title: Timely & transparent
pillars.desc: Clear pricing and prompt updates, so you always know where your order stands.

capabilities.title: What We Do
capabilities.subtitle: Everything you need to move from concept to container, handled under one roof.

items.title: Single-Window Sourcing
items.desc: One office coordinating the right Pakistani vendors, so you deal with us, not a dozen factories.

items.title: Vendor Network Access
items.desc: Direct access to a trusted network of apparel and denim manufacturers across Pakistan.

items.title: Order Coordination
items.desc: We manage timelines, samples, and follow-ups end to end, keeping every order moving.

items.title: Quality Oversight
items.desc: On-the-ground supervision at our partner factories to keep production on spec.

items.title: Clear Communication
items.desc: Timely, transparent updates at every step. It's the difference our buyers rely on.

items.title: Logistics & Export
items.desc: Documentation, consolidation, and shipping coordinated to your destination.

products.title: Apparel & denim we source
products.subtitle: A focused portfolio for importers and fashion brands, from knits and wovens to full denim programs.

items.title: Product R&D

items.title: Shipping & Logistics Supervision

cta.title: Let's build something lasting

footer.tagline: Our single window to Pakistan's apparel and denim.
